proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 811 article gives Malayalam eri heat, burning, pungency; eriyuka to burn, be consumed; erivu pungency, zeal; ericcal burning, smarting of eyes, mouth, etc.; erikka to kindle fire, burn ( tr. ); erippu flame, torch; eruvu pungency.. The Malayalam survey form eriy “burn (something)” is proposed within this article family.
